## Core Services in Pune & Maharashtra
1. **Solar Panel Installation in Pune** (https://www.rayzonarenewablesenergy.com/solar-installation-pune)
   - End-to-end solar EPC services for homes, housing societies, commercial properties, and factories.
   - Free rooftop assessment, shade analysis, system engineering, Tier-1 panel procurement, and grid synchronization.

2. **Residential Rooftop Solar** (https://www.rayzonarenewablesenergy.com/residential-solar)
   - On-grid rooftop solar systems for bungalows, row houses, villas, and cooperative housing societies (CHS).
   - PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana central government subsidy processing (up to ₹78,000 subsidy on 3 kW systems).
   - Expected electricity bill reduction: Up to 90%.

3. **Commercial & Industrial Solar** (https://www.rayzonarenewablesenergy.com/commercial-solar)
   - High-capacity solar plants (10 kW to 500+ kW) for offices, IT parks, warehouses, hospitals, hotels, and manufacturing units.
   - Drastic reduction in operational expenditure and fast ROI (3–5 years).

4. **On-Grid Solar Systems with Net Metering** (https://www.rayzonarenewablesenergy.com/on-grid-solar)
   - Grid-tied solar systems connected to MSEDCL (Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited).
   - Full paperwork and meter installation for bi-directional net metering to export surplus solar electricity.

5. **Solar Maintenance & AMC Services** (https://www.rayzonarenewablesenergy.com/solar-maintenance)
   - Preventive maintenance, high-efficiency solar panel cleaning, inverter health diagnosis, string testing, and Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC).

6. **EV Charging Station Installation** (https://www.rayzonarenewablesenergy.com/ev-charging)
   - AC Level 2 home chargers, commercial multi-point chargers, and solar-integrated EV charging systems for societies and businesses.

7. **Solar Street Lights & Products** (https://www.rayzonarenewablesenergy.com/products-services)
   - All-in-one solar LED street lights (180W, 240W, 300W, 400W) with automatic dusk-to-dawn sensors and lithium batteries.
